name: The Radiants
source:
When an ordinary college student witnesses the death of a young woman, she is thrust into a world she never knew existed -- a world alongside her own filled with magic, danger, and a cast of unbelievable characters. Forced to take the place of the woman she tried to save, she must prove herself by passing the trials of the Radiant Council or risk losing her memories forever.. 

[From [url=https://rosearcanagames.itch.io/the-radiants]itch.io[/url]]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rosearcana/the-radiants-a-magical-adventure-visual-novel]Funded using Kickstarter.[/url]
translation:
一位普通大學生目睹了一名年輕女子的死亡，就此闖入一個從未想過竟然存在的世界。它與自己的世界並行，充滿魔法、危險，以及形形色色令人難以置信的角色。她被迫接替自己曾試圖拯救的女子的位置，必須通過光輝議會的試煉，證明自己，否則就有永遠失去記憶的危險。

[摘自[url=https://rosearcanagames.itch.io/the-radiants]itch.io[/url]]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/rosearcana/the-radiants-a-magical-adventure-visual-novel]本作透過Kickstarter募得資金。[/url]
